claims.claim: Train and release a family of LLMs up to 16.1B parameters (CodeGen) on natural language and programming language data
claims.quote: To democratize this, we train and release a family of large language models up to 16.1B parameters, called C ODE G EN, on natural language

claims.claim: Open source the custom training library JAXFORMER for TPU-v4
claims.quote: We will open source model checkpoints2 and the custom training library: JAX FORMER.3

claims.claim: Model is competitive with previous state of the art on zero-shot Python code generation on HumanEval
claims.quote: We show the utility of the trained model by demonstrating that it is competitive with the previous state-of-the-art on zero-shot Python code generation on HumanEval.

claims.claim: Study multi-turn program synthesis emerging in autoregressive models under scaling laws
claims.quote: We study multi-turn program synthesis emerging in autoregressive models under scaling laws.

claims.claim: Introduce a multi-turn program synthesis paradigm; multi-turn specification improves synthesis over single-turn
claims.quote: Our analysis on MTPB shows that the same intent provided to C ODE G EN in multi- turn fashion significantly improves program synthesis over that provided as a single turn.

claims.claim: Novel open Multi-Turn Programming Benchmark (MTPB) with 115 problems, first multi-turn program synthesis benchmark
claims.quote: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first multi-turn program synthesis benchmark, which allows quantitative analysis of multi-turn program synthesis.

rerun.quote: All models are evaluated with temperature t ∈ {0.2, 0.6, 0.8}, and we compute pass@k where k ∈ {1, 10, 100} for each model.
